decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is far from the core offer and serves a niche defence and maritime market, but such contracts are long-cycle, and a large firm with slack can keep carrying a line whose results are still uncertain rather than trigger search for other uses.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build on core competencies and are still being developed further with the LED retrofit kit, so performance appears at or above aspiration.

The relaunched designer task light is close to the core offer and cheap to maintain, and nothing points to a shortfall serious enough to prompt problemistic search, though small design items are often pruned.
The pendant office luminaire fits the established office lighting portfolio and was launched recently, so management would give it more time against its aspiration level.
The premium pendant line with several models matches the firm's energy-efficient LED strategy and core competencies, making it likely to be retained.
